editor.note: Tightened hook by cutting the weak sigh and leading directly into the pain point; sharpened step and payoff voice lines for higher energy and punchiness (total 65 spoken words).

attention_plan.biggest_risk: Viewers swiping during the prompt extraction step (Scene 3) due to wall-of-text fatigue; solved by punching the voiceover with high-urgency keywords ('strict deadlines') and cueing Tick with an energetic 'wow' mouth-open reaction.
